prompts.label: Design a landing page
prompts.prompt: Design a landing page for a product. Start by asking what the product is and who it's for if it isn't clear. Then propose a headline, a short subheadline, a primary call to action, and a simple section layout (hero, features, social proof, footer). Keep the copy concise and the design clean.

prompts.label: Draft a professional email
prompts.prompt: Draft a professional email. Tell me the recipient, the goal of the email, and any key points to include. Write a clear subject line, a polite opening, the main message in the body, and a specific call to action or next step in the closing. Keep it short and easy to read.

prompts.label: Brainstorm ideas for a side project
prompts.prompt: Brainstorm ideas for a side project. Ask about my interests, skills, and how much time I have, then suggest several realistic project ideas. For each idea, give a one-line pitch, the core feature to build first, and why it would be fun or worthwhile.

prompts.label: Remember that I prefer concise answers
prompts.prompt: Remember that I prefer concise answers. Going forward, keep responses short and to the point, skip unnecessary preamble, and lead with the answer or result. Only add detail when I ask for it.
